name: D2-builder
tagline: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub. Docker. Com/r/linuxserver/d2-builder for details.
description: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub.docker.com/r/linuxserver/d2-builder for details.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/d2-builder:0.9.0@sha256:7f0d8cc53cb1ff88430a9dc30121f1350bafcd5c97f043b88d879ead04adbaf1
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
